evals.prompt: Run the theory-building-review skill: We merged a few checkout and invoice changes this week. Tell us where our domain model may be drifting.
evals.expected_output: A repository-scoped theory-building review that inspects recent diffs or commits, reconstructs checkout/invoice domain concepts, identifies conceptual drift with file references, and gives concrete refactor/test/doc action items.

evals.prompt: Use `theory-building-review`: Before I refactor the auth module, audit whether the current code expresses the domain model clearly. I want findings, not implementation yet.
evals.expected_output: A conceptual-fit review of the auth domain that focuses on vocabulary, boundaries, invariants, and theory preservation, with grounded findings and no code edits.

evals.prompt: Run the weekly theory-building-review skill on this codebase. Pick one module I touched recently, explain the system theory, and give me 3 action items to improve my craft.
evals.expected_output: A weekly practice report based on recent changes or high-signal modules, including a theory summary, strong signals, findings, 3 concrete action items, and open questions.
